name: Tool-First Blind Copying
problem: Adopting popular external tools or framework brands without analyzing their underlying mechanisms, trade-offs, or applicability to EOS.
symptoms: Adding npm packages simply because an external repository uses them
Creating complex microservices for single-machine local workflows
Claiming compliance based on tool name rather than empirical evidence
consequences: Loss of local-first control plane simplicity
root_cause: Selecting tools by popularity rather than mechanism fit under current governance constraints.
mitigation: Enforce Section 4 Mechanism Analysis: Evaluate Problem, Why, Responsibility, Inputs, Outputs, Invariants, Failure Modes, Evidence, and Test Strategy before adoption.
evidence: RSC-0001: Epistemological analysis of Engram memory mechanisms prior to policy adoption
